http/internal/http2_frame#

HTTP/2 frames (RFC 9113 §4): the 9-byte header, the payload, the rules every frame must follow, and the faults that end a stream or a connection.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

HTTP/2 frames (RFC 9113 §4): the 9-byte header, the payload, the rules every frame must follow, and the faults that end a stream or a connection.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.
